name: S-Class Key Guardian
body:
S-class key guardians can pick up any blade in their vicinity and transform it into their weapon of choice, making it easier for them to gain energy even in situations where their normal equipment has been lost, damaged, or taken from them. As they gain experience, these key guardians learn to imbue their keyblades directly with magic. They’re also better at guarding their minds and bodies while they have the energy to do so.

Role: S-class key guardians are just as fast in combat as their traditional counterparts. With greater defensive ability, they can also serve as a mobile protector in the right circumstances for their allies.

Alignment: Any.

Hit Die: d10.

Starting Wealth: 3d6 × 10 gp (average 105 gp.)

Class Skills

The s-class key guardian’s class skills are Acrobatics (Dex), Climb (Str), Craft (Int), Diplomacy (Cha), Disable Device (Dex), Escape Artist (Dex), Intimidate (Cha), Knowledge (arcana) (Int), Knowledge (dungeoneering) (Int), Knowledge (planes) (Int), Profession (Wis), Ride (Dex), Sense Motive (Wis), Spellcraft (Int), and Swim (Str).
